thought.text: All infrastructure checks pass. Let me follow the frontend redirect to confirm the SvelteKit UI actually renders.

reasoning_content:
Everything's fine. The reason the frontend's HTML was empty when piped to head -c 400 is probably because the redirect (303) response has no body — I didn't use `-L`. Let me follow the redirect, confirm that the SvelteKit page actually renders, and check whether it's the login page or the map page.

Also, let me verify the tileserver's behavior (tilejson 200 has already been confirmed). Let me quickly check the frontend with -L.

action.command:
cd /workspace/deployment
echo '=== follow redirect ==='
curl -skL --resolve app.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -o /tmp/app.html -w 'final HTTP %{http_code}, url: %{url_effective}\n' https://app.localhost/
head -c 500 /tmp/app.html; echo
echo '---'
grep -o 'sveltekit\|<title>[^<]*</title>\|login' /tmp/app.html | sort | uniq -c | head
echo '=== static asset check ==='
ASSET=$(grep -o '/_app/[^"]*\.js' /tmp/app.html | head -1)
echo "asset: $ASSET"
if [ -n "$ASSET" ]; then curl -sk --resolve app.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code} size=%{size_download}\n' "https://app.localhost$ASSET"; fi
